description: E1-E7 paper experiments (Figs. 7, 8, 9 and Table II): every original, paper-text, B2-classical and Fig. 9 sensitivity config, seeds 0-9. Comparison sweep: no candidate selection.

metrics.regression (Figs. 7, 9): training mean squared loss logged at the last epoch (loss before the final update, same convention as the released CSVs); validation MSE on 500 Haar states as a secondary metric
metrics.classification (Fig. 8, Table II): validation accuracy on 500 Haar states after the last update, under both prediction rules (linear sign Tr[H rho] = released code; activation sign Tr[tanh(H/T) rho] = paper text); final training logistic loss

plan.direction: loss: lower is better; accuracy: higher is better
plan.checkpoint: final epoch of the configured budget (Fig. 7: 2000, Fig. 8: 500, Fig. 9: 10000); no early stopping or best-epoch selection
plan.aggregation: per (config, model): mean, sample std, median, min, max over the 10 seeds, full precision; losses also summarized in log10
plan.comparison_rule: paired by seed (same target draw and states for all models in a config): quantum minus classical (and tanh minus linear for Fig. 9) differences of log10 loss or of accuracy; two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test, n = 10; a claim direction is supported when the median paired difference has the claimed sign and p < 0.05
plan.tie_tolerance: |median paired difference| < 0.1 decade (loss) or < 1 accuracy point is reported as a tie
plan.selection: none (no hyperparameter or model selection in this sweep)
plan.paper_comparison: Fig. 7 and Fig. 8 against the released CSVs, Table II against the crop, Fig. 9 against pixel readings; the paper's single run is placed within our 10-seed distribution (rank and range)
